svg.text: EvoAtlas - AI Assisted Pokemon Evolution Explorer
Tomorrow focus: one information-space sketch plus one medium-fidelity interaction screen.
which trigger category each branch belongs to
Why this sketch matters for crit
1. It shows the structure of the information space instead of only one answer.
2. It gives the AI a vocabulary for parsing user constraints into filter categories.
- I chose the Tool model, so the AI acts like a constraint interpreter instead of a personality.
- This taxonomy makes the evolution system understandable as categories, not just isolated facts.
- Eevee is a good example because one chain spans inventory, bond, and complex trigger types.
- The interface uses this taxonomy to filter branches and explain why paths are valid or blocked.
Which Eevee evolution needs no trade and no item?
keep only bond and move routes
Most flexible because it does not
It is not acting like a character.
Query entry point opens the encyclopedic search space
Blue paths are valid, gray paths are blocked by constraints
Tool model: AI panel explains reasoning instead of chatting
Say this in crit: The taxonomy on the left structures the domain, and this screen shows how the AI uses that structure to filter and explain evolution paths.
